item.title: The Google vs. Everyone Else GEO Problem
item.description: Google says llms.txt isn't required for AI Overviews. ClaudeBot can't render JavaScript. Perplexity and ChatGPT both use llms.txt. Here's why optimizing for the hardest crawler covers everything.
